question: What is the relationship between the path of time and the path of space?
premises: The path of time, consisting of the Lord's power of action, has already been examined.
The path of space arises in relation to the variety of forms.
The path of space is now being defined.
inference: After explaining the temporal path rooted in action, the text turns to the spatial path rooted in the diversity of forms.
uncertainties: The compound mūrtivaicitryajastajjo is compressed and may allow slightly different readings.
plain_english: The path of time, made of the Lord's power of action, has already been examined; now the path of space, connected with the variety of forms, is being defined.
